invariants: Project lifecycle is the only project-level state authority.
Run stages record execution progress and do not imply delivery.
Material maturity is a label and does not create a second state machine.
Lifecycle self-transitions are invalid; progress within a state belongs in a checkpoint or event receipt.
A delivered project may re-enter reviewing only as an explicit, digest-bound revision transition.
A state transition never implies a file write, human approval, publication, or business outcome.
